## City of Malden

Malden City Hall

215 Pleasant Street Malden, MA 02148

## Meeting Minutes - Final Rules & Ordinance Committee

Councillor Winslow, Chair

Councillor Colon Hayes, Vice-Chair

- Councillor Crowe
- Councillor Linehan
- Councillor O'Malley

Tuesday, June 23, 2026

6:30 PM

215 Pleasant Street

Room 105

Malden, MA 02148

## Watch the meeting with Teams: https://tinyurl.com/mv993mkp

A quorum of the City Council may be present at this meeting. While no formal votes or actions are anticipated by the City Council, members may participate in the discussion of topics listed on this agenda. This notice is filed to ensure compliance with the Open Meeting Law should a quorum of the parent body be present.

## Roll Call

Chair Winslow called the meeting to order at 6:32 PM.

Also in attendance were Maria Luise, Ron Hogan, and Prasanna Ragasekaran.

Present: 4 - Stephen Winslow, Karen Colon Hayes, Peg Crowe and Ryan O'Malley

Absent: 1 - Amanda Linehan

## Minutes to be Approved

**332-26** 

Minutes for the meeting of March 24, 2026

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor O'Malley, that the Committee Minutes be approved. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

**333-26** 

Minutes for the meeting of May 5, 2026

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor O'Malley, that the Committee Minutes be approved. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Business

**317-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 2.16.030 CANNABIS LICENSING AND ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION is hereby amended by striking Subsection C and inserting the following:

C. The Cannabis Licensing and Enforcement Commission shall consist of three (3) members, as follows:

- 1. Police Chief
- 2. Building Commissioner
- 3. City Staff member with finance background as appointed by Mayor

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow

Attachments: Current 2.16.030 Cannabis Licensing and Enforcement Commission Ordinance

Councillor Colon Hayes expressed concern for cutting citizen representation from the CLEC, which was done as a part of fiscal cut backs. The committee ran out of time before they were able to fully deliberate on this topic so the paper was tabled for the time being.

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor O'Malley, that the Ordinance be tabled. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

**318-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC)

2.16.040 CEMETERY TRUSTEES is hereby amended by striking subsection (A) and inserting the following:

A. City cemeteries shall be under the care and management of three (3) trustees, all of whom shall be chosen by the City Council for a term of five years. Commencement of the three-member board shall take effect at such time as the current five-member board is reduced by attrition.

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow

Attachments: Current 2.16.040 Cemetery Trustees Ordinance

Final Paper: 318-26

A motion was made by Councillor Crowe, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that the Ordinance be recommended favorably to the City Council. The motion carried by a 3-1 voice vote.

Councillor O'Malley dissenting.

**319-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 2.16.090 EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT BOARD is hereby amended by:

1. Striking Subsection A in its entirety and inserting the following:

A. The Emergency Management Board shall be comprised of the Police Chief or their designee, the Fire Chief or their designee, the Director of Public Works, the Director of Public Health, and the Director of Public Facilities.

2. Adding the following to Subsection D(1):

Oversight of the Emergency Management Board shall be the responsibility of the Director of Emergency Management, who shall be designated by the Mayor from either the Police Chief or their designee or the Fire Chief or their designee.

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow

Attachments: Current 2.16.090 Emergency Management Board Ordinance

- Final Paper 319-26 2.16.090 Emergency Management Board
- Ordinance Amendment

Councillor McDonald asked if the entire ordinance could be amended to reflect gender neutral pronouns.

Councillor O'Malley made a motion to move the last sentence that begins with, "Oversight of the Emergency Management Board shall be..." to subsection D.1 for clarity of reading.

A motion was made by Councillor O'Malley, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that the Ordinance be amended. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

A motion was made by Councillor Crowe, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that the Ordinance be recommended favorably as amended to the City Council. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

**320-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) 4.12.020 BUILDING PERMIT FEES Subsection C is hereby amended by striking ‘$16’ and inserting ‘$18’ in its place.

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow

Attachments: Current 4.12.020 Building Permit Fees Ordinance

Final Paper: 320-26

A motion was made by Councillor Colon Hayes, seconded by Councillor Crowe, that the Ordinance be recommended favorably to the City Council. The motion carried by a unanimous vote.

## Adjournment

A motion was made by Councillor O'Malley, seconded by Councillor Colon Hayes, that this be adjourned. The motion carried unanimously. Meeting adjourned at 7:02 PM.

If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000 Ext. 2005

For instructions on enabling live translated captions in Teams, please visit: www.cityofmalden.org/captions
headline: Tabled a cannabis commission ordinance, recommended cemetery trustee, emergency management, and building permit fee ordinance changes to the City Council.
summary: The committee reviewed four proposed ordinance changes covering the Cannabis Licensing and Enforcement Commission, Cemetery Trustees, the Emergency Management Board, and Building Permit Fees. It tabled the cannabis commission ordinance, recommended the cemetery trustee ordinance favorably by a 3-1 vote, amended and then recommended favorably the emergency management ordinance, and recommended favorably the building permit fee ordinance.
decisions: Tabled Ordinance 317-26 (Cannabis Licensing and Enforcement Commission changes) by a unanimous vote.
Recommended favorably to the City Council Ordinance 318-26 (Cemetery Trustees changes) by a 3-1 voice vote, with Councillor O'Malley dissenting.
Amended Ordinance 319-26 (Emergency Management Board changes) by a unanimous vote.
Recommended favorably as amended to the City Council Ordinance 319-26 (Emergency Management Board changes) by a unanimous vote.
Recommended favorably to the City Council Ordinance 320-26 (Building Permit Fees increase from $16 to $18) by a unanimous vote.
